Class Camera

java.lang.Object
renderer.Camera
All Implemented Interfaces:
Cloneable
public class Camera extends Object implements Cloneable
Represents a camera in 3D space for rendering scenes using ray tracing. The camera defines the viewpoint, orientation, and viewport settings.
